svg.aria-label: Echovolve teacher app UI mockup: six Android screens covering one lesson start to finish, the weekly report in English and Amharic, and the teacher's own data controls.
svg.title: Echovolve — teacher app UI mockup
svg.desc: Target user interface for the Echovolve Android teacher app. Row one shows starting a lesson, the in-lesson screen, and the saved-lesson summary. Row two shows the weekly report in English, the same report in Amharic, and the teacher's consent and data controls. All values are illustrative fixtures, not measurements.
svg.text: Target UI for the Android teacher app. Values are illustrative fixtures, not measurements. Nothing in this repository implements these screens.
